title: Initial boundary-tag validity
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet and let $x$ be a finite binary word. The initial configuration of $N$ on $x$, whose input head is at position $1$, satisfies the virtual boundary-tag condition with tag $\mathrm{true}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet
replaced: For every nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet and every input string $x$, the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ satisfies the virtual boundary-tag invariant with the interior tag value (its input head starts at position one, inside the window).
